scope: Actual Creator build; normal mouse/keyboard reward path, page reloads, pause save/load, download, file chooser import, corruption rejection, battle checkpoint and isolated-browser file import.
checks: a fresh browser exposes an empty single-player save slot
loading an empty slot reports the missing save without starting a run
starting a normal game creates a durable browser save
normal reward selection is saved while awaiting a slot
refresh returns to the menu with a readable save
Continue restores the exact pending reward and offer without rerolling
equipping the earned skill persists null slots and the ember claim
the pause menu saves and reports successful persistence
Export downloads a validated file containing the earned skill
Restart retains the previous save until a new game starts
a deliberately started new game has empty skills
the file chooser imports the backup into normal gameplay
a corrupt file reports failure and keeps the paused current build
a rejected file cannot overwrite the durable save
departure automatically writes the combat start checkpoint
manual battle save/load returns to the wave start and pauses for the player
battle loading retains the obtained skill and gives feedback
the player can resume the battle normally after loading
a second real refresh can continue the battle checkpoint
a separate browser can import the file and create its own durable save
single-player persistence and actual file dialogs produce no Creator browser errors
